disclaimer: Anomalies are statistical deviations from expected consumption. They do not by themselves prove electricity theft, equipment failure or meter malfunction; each requires on-site or metadata verification.
baseline: median of same hour-of-week over previous 4 weeks (causal)
severity_rule: max(|rolling z|, |robust z|) of the deviation from the causal baseline: >=8 critical, >=6 high, >=4 medium, else low
